stories.text:
B' H'. I was an antissemite in the past, not really angry or made bad things to anyone, but jokes, etc. Rabbi Mizrachi changed my life. Reading Rambam. I will explicit say sorry here to anyone that i may hurt with jokes or gossip. 

Thank you, Rabbi Mizrachi. Wish you spoke more to gentiles, you penetrate our heart with truth and it's hard to handle, but HaShem help in the end.

Blessed be Yisrael and the Jews in Yeshivots! Torah is the truth.

stories.text:
Rabbi Mizrachi; i want to take this opportunity to thank  you for teaching me certain truths which have made me a better goy senior man...

i have been listining to your lectures and i have become obediant in the Power of the Sacred Noahide Laws...i strongly believe and feel the power of these sacred commandments...

for many years I was not in a righetous relationship with the L-RD Almighty...after listining to your lectures for several years (approx. 3) an now  which i continue to walk in the path of The L-RD Almighty...it is a comforting, and a peaceful thoughtful feeling...

i feel the power of the TRUTH of The TORAH...

thank you and may HIS Power always be with you as it did with Moses and as it did with David and now with you.

AMEEN
